messages.en: I think it'd be even more fun if I knew the baseball rules better.
They said they'd cue our 'out song' dance if I memorized it.
But sadly, I didn't get to dance it.
I memorized it really well too.
Still, my first ceremonial first hit at a baseball game
ended in a win, so I'm really happy.
The players worked hard too.
LG Twins, fighting!
Hang on a second, I'm in a lesson right now.
Wait for me~
I'm back!
Victory fairy photo ✨
I wonder when my next ceremonial pitch will be~~
Today was really fun.
tripleS = lucky charms for wins.
I make up a pretty big part of that~
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I'll work hard in my lesson now.
I wonder when it'll end...
Haranghae ❤️❤️
